title: Render dotted placeholders without rescanning
prompt: Implement and export render in src/template-render.js. Signature: render(template, data). Replace every well-formed placeholder `{{ path }}` in template with String(value) of the value found in data, and leave all other text unchanged. A well-formed placeholder is `{{`, optional whitespace, a path, optional whitespace, and `}}`; whitespace means any JavaScript whitespace character. A path is one or more dot-separated segments, where each segment is a non-empty run of characters that contains no whitespace, no braces, and no dot. Look up each segment as an own property of the current value, from left to right, starting at data (for example `{{ user.name }}` reads data['user']['name'], and `{{ items.0 }}` reads the first array element). A segment is missing when the current value is not a non-null object, does not have that own property, or the property value is undefined; throw TypeError when any segment is missing. Insert the final value once with String(value) (null becomes 'null', 0 becomes '0', false becomes 'false', and the empty string stays empty) and never scan inserted text again for placeholders; there is no HTML escaping. Text that is not a well-formed placeholder, including lone braces, an empty placeholder, and a placeholder whose path contains whitespace, is copied verbatim. Throw TypeError if template is not a string, if data is not a non-null object (arrays are allowed), or if a path cannot be resolved. An empty template returns ''. Keep the existing export.
